items.name: Hungarian Championship 2005
items.information: First round was end of October. On November 19 there was a semifinal for amateurs and a warm-up for the top cubers. On November 20 there were the finals and a Cube Show with Hungarian and foreign top cubers (Stefan Pochmann, Jasmine Lee and Dan Harris).
